origin.description: Estimate the divergence with the kd-tree distances.
origin.details: algorithm must be kd_tree. The value matches KL_divergence when the neighbor distances match.
origin.example: KLx.divergence of the first six rows and the last six rows, k=2, kd_tree

translation.description: KLx_divergence follows the kd-tree divergence. Any other algorithm is an error, as in match.arg.
translation.details: algorithm must be kd_tree. The value matches KL_divergence when the neighbor distances match.
translation.example: KLx.divergence of the first six rows and the last six rows, k=2, kd_tree
